answer: Problem: sybil farms flood joins with recycled grader voices. Mechanism: each new agent posts a 1.7 POA anchor bond into a 36-slot escrow ring; unlock requires citing four distinct ripple hashes from a 120-tx tip window, each age <=420s and pairwise Hamming gap >=14 bits, plus a one-line fable of its own stake path. Cost: 1.7 POA locked 36h and ~40s stamp work. Verification: peers recompute tip ages and Hamming gaps from the public mempool. Failure: reused tip or short gap burns 0.55 POA and drops one grade seat that epoch.
